title: Multiple Risk Factor Intervention Trial for the Prevention of Coronary Heart Disease (MRFIT)
brief_summary: To determine for a group of men at high risk of death from coronary heart disease whether a special intervention program to lower serum cholesterol, reduce blood pressure, and eliminate cigarette smoking would result in a significant reduction in mortality from coronary heart disease.
raw_criteria:
Men, ages 35-57. One or more of three risk factors--hypertension, hypercholesterolemia, and cigarette smoking.

Free from coronary heart disease.
